notes: `guard code == 0 else { throw ForgeError.installerFailed(code) }` (line 353) fires before both the `findArgsFile` guard (line 355) and the `try? removeItem(installerJar)` cleanup (line 358) -- a failed installer run leaves `forge-installer.jar` sitting in the server directory with nothing cleaning it up.
